syllabus_topics: Basic combinatorial configurations. Binomial coefficients. Inclusion-exclusion principle.
Prefix trees. Text compression and Huffman coding. Comparison of implementations in different languages.
Memory management: simple memory management, virtual memory, paging, segmentation. Page replacement algorithms.
Types of proofs. Direct and indirect proof. Proof by contradiction. (Illustrated on basic number theory: divisibility, primality, etc.) Mathematical induction.
Divide and conquer sorting algorithms. Use of recursion, possible problems with recursion in different languages. Properties of bottom-up merge-sort algorithm.
Network security - security problems and mechanisms at different layers - VLAN.
Discrete probability. Experiment and random event. Bernoulli scheme. Conditional probability. Bayes' theorem.
Efficient implementations of Set and Multiset data structures. Comparison of implementations in different languages.

Database design: relational data model, entity-relationship data model, relationship cardinality, entity roles, n-ary relationships, transforming entity-relationship model to relational, representing subsets, data contextualization, reification, meta-modeling, types and their explicit storage.
Relations on a set. Equivalence relation and set partitions. Partially ordered sets.
Error handling, assert, exceptions, tests, differences in different languages.

Modeling and design: entity-relationship diagram, data flow diagram, UML diagrams: use-case, state, activity, sequence, component, class, deployment. The student can draw an example of each diagram and explain it.
Injective, surjective and bijective mappings. Countable and uncountable sets. Cantor's diagonalization method.
Efficient representations of the graph data structure. Use of the Union-find problem in finding the spanning tree of a graph.
Network architecture, layered models, services - layer, interface, protocol, physical and logical data flow. Key issues in network design.
Limit and continuity of functions of one real variable.
Efficient implementations of the associative array data structure. Collision resolution. Implementations of associative arrays in different languages.

Device management and file management: controller, methods of data transfer between controller and memory. Device management software. Concept of file and directory, types of files, character encoding methods in text files.
Derivative of functions of one real variable and its use in investigating function behavior.
Efficient implementation of PriorityQueue operations. Comparison of implementations in different languages.

Operating system from an external perspective (services, their importance from the perspective of higher layers of the computer's layered model) and from an internal perspective (process management, memory management, device management, and file management). Main tasks of individual management components.
Primitive function and methods of its calculation.
Algorithms for traversing tree data structures. Possibilities of implementation using lazy algorithms in different languages.

Organization of computer systems - layered model of a computer, relationships between layers. Processor (microprocessor, ALU, instruction execution), internal and external memory, peripheral devices, bus from both hardware and software perspectives.
First-order logic: Syntax (symbols, terms, formulas) and semantics (structure, term value, satisfaction of formula and theory). Implication, independence, unsatisfiability and their relationship.
Tree data structures. Differences in implementation using dynamic data structures in different languages.
Computer systems: Basic logical functions and their realization. Boolean functions. Some combinational circuits (adder, multiplexer and demultiplexer).
Deterministic finite automaton (definition, configuration, computation step, computation, language it accepts).
Methods of state space search, depth-first and breadth-first, Dijkstra's algorithm. Comparison of implementations in different languages.
Client vs. server web applications, principle of operation, explanation of network communication and its processing.
Nondeterministic finite automaton (definition, configuration, computation step, computation, language it accepts).
Asymptotic computational complexity, big O notation, amortized complexity.
Process and thread synchronization - data sharing, temporal dependency, mutual exclusion, critical section, deadlock, busy waiting.
Turing machine, comparison with finite automaton. Does a language exist that cannot be recognized by any TM?
Linear data structures (list, queue, stack), efficient implementation using dynamic data structures. Differences in implementation in different languages.
Server-side web applications, primarily PHP (alt. Python, Ruby,...), connecting PHP (alt. Python, Ruby,...) with a database, processing and handling user data, data transfer between pages.
Tableau or resolution calculus: Calculus rules for first-order logic. State the correctness and completeness theorem, explain its relationship to implication.
Role of abstract data type, differences in implementation in different languages.

Web: basic document structure, metadata, sections and headings, grouping and text-level semantic elements, forms. CSS properties, their values, selectors, box model, static, relative, absolute and fixed positioning, media queries.
assessment_rules: The indicative rating scale is A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. The scale of assessment (preliminary/final) is 0/100.
